{{Recipe summary
| Category = Cake recipes
| Yield = About 15 ea. 2 ½-inch muffins
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Sifting|sifted]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ¼ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 cup cooked and mashed [[Cookbook:Pumpkin|pumpkin]] (canned pumpkin can be used as well)
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon into a bowl.
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] egg; mix in milk, pumpkin, and oil.
#Make a well in center of flour mixture; pour in pumpkin mixture all at once.
#Stir quickly until flour is just moistened.
#Fill greased [[Cookbook:Muffin Pan|muffin cups]] ⅔ full.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 425°F for 25 minutes, or until a [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] inserted into the center comes out clean.
#Run spatula around each muffin to loosen; serve immediately.

steps.text: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon into a bowl.
Beat egg; mix in milk, pumpkin, and oil.
Make a well in center of flour mixture; pour in pumpkin mixture all at once.
Stir quickly until flour is just moistened.
Fill greased muffin cups ⅔ full.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Run spatula around each muffin to loosen; serve immediately.
